Mission BBQ Menu: A BBQ Feast for Meat Lovers Everywhere

Mission BBQ is a beloved restaurant for barbecue enthusiasts, offering a wide range of delicious smoked meats, homemade sides, and signature BBQ sauces. Whether you’re looking for a dine-in experience, takeout, or delivery, Mission BBQ delivers flavorful options that honor the American tradition of BBQ. With a menu that suits both individuals and groups, Mission BBQ offers something for every occasion.

This guide provides a detailed overview of the Mission BBQ menu, along with pricing information, delivery options, and catering services. You’ll also find insights into seasonal specials and the restaurant’s dedication to serving our nation’s heroes.

Mission BBQ Menu: A BBQ Feast for Meat Lovers Everywhere

Mission BBQ Menu Overview and Pricing

The Mission BBQ menu features a variety of smoked meats, sandwiches, and sides, all cooked with care and seasoned to perfection. Here’s a quick overview of their core menu items along with pricing.

Menu Item Price

Mission BBQ Meat Selections

Mission BBQ is known for its wide selection of expertly smoked meats. Each item is smoked low and slow to achieve the perfect tenderness and flavor. Whether you prefer beef, pork, or chicken, Mission BBQ has something for every BBQ lover.

Brisket – $12.99/lb

Brisket is a signature item at Mission BBQ. It’s slow-cooked to perfection, ensuring a tender, melt-in-your-mouth experience. Served with your choice of BBQ sauce, the brisket is a must-try for meat lovers.

Pulled Pork – $10.99/lb

Mission BBQ’s pulled pork is slow-cooked and hand-pulled, making it juicy and full of flavor. Perfect on its own or served as a sandwich, it’s a BBQ classic.

St. Louis Ribs – $14.99 (half rack), $24.99 (full rack)

These ribs are smoked and seasoned with a blend of spices that make them tender and flavorful. Whether you choose a half rack or full rack, they come served with your choice of sides.

Pulled Chicken – $11.99/lb

For a lighter option, the pulled chicken at Mission BBQ is a great choice. Smoked and shredded, it’s perfect in sandwiches or on a platter.

Smoked Sausage – $9.99/lb

Mission BBQ’s smoked sausage links are a savory addition to any meal. They’re packed with flavor and pair well with any of the homemade sides.

Mission BBQ Sandwiches and Pricing

If you’re looking for a quick bite or something portable, Mission BBQ sandwiches are a great option. Packed with smoked meats and served on soft buns, these sandwiches are perfect for lunch or dinner.

Sandwich Price
Brisket Sandwich $8.99
Pulled Pork Sandwich $7.99
Pulled Chicken Sandwich $7.99
Sausage Sandwich $7.99

Each sandwich is served with your choice of BBQ sauce and can be paired with one of Mission BBQ’s delicious homemade sides for an additional cost.

Sides and BBQ Sauces

No BBQ meal is complete without the perfect sides and sauces to complement your smoked meats. Mission BBQ offers a range of homemade sides that add flavor and texture to your meal.

Side Dish Price
Mac and Cheese $3.49
Potato Salad $2.99
Baked Beans $2.99
Cornbread $1.99

Mission BBQ also offers a variety of BBQ sauces, including sweet, spicy, and tangy options. You can buy a bottle of their signature BBQ sauce for $5.99.

Mission BBQ Delivery and Takeout Options

Mission BBQ makes it easy to enjoy their delicious menu from the comfort of your own home. Whether you’re ordering for a family dinner or a special event, you can place your order online and choose between delivery or takeout.

Order Online for Takeout or Delivery

To place an order, simply visit the Mission BBQ website and browse the menu. You can select your items, customize your order, and choose between pickup or delivery. Delivery options are available in most locations and are quick and reliable.

  • Takeout: Choose this option for fast pickup at your local Mission BBQ.
  • Delivery: Get your order delivered to your doorstep through the Mission BBQ website or popular delivery platforms.

Catering Options and Pricing

If you’re hosting an event or gathering, Mission BBQ offers comprehensive catering services. Whether it’s a small get-together or a large celebration, they offer catering packages that include smoked meats, sides, and desserts.

Catering Packages

Catering Package Price
Family BBQ Feast (serves 4) $49.99
Party Pack (serves 12) $149.99
BBQ Bundle (serves 20) $249.99

Each catering package includes a combination of meats, sides, and sauces. You can also customize your order based on your preferences and the size of your event.

Seasonal Specials and Limited-Time Offers 

Throughout the year, Mission BBQ introduces seasonal specials and limited-time offers that give customers the chance to try new dishes and flavors.

Kansas City Burnt Ends – $13.99/lb

A Kansas City specialty, burnt ends are flavorful chunks of beef that are crispy on the outside and tender on the inside. Available for a limited time.

BBQ Pulled Pork Tacos – $9.99 (3 tacos)

Mission BBQ puts a unique twist on BBQ by offering pulled pork tacos. These tacos are packed with flavor and served with your choice of sauce.

Smoked Turkey Legs – $10.99 each

Available during the holiday season, smoked turkey legs are a great option for those looking to enjoy BBQ flavors with a seasonal twist.

First Responder and Veteran Appreciation

Mission BBQ takes pride in honoring first responders and veterans. Each day at noon, the restaurant pauses to play the national anthem, showing its appreciation for those who serve. Additionally, Mission BBQ donates a portion of its proceeds to various organizations supporting veterans and first responders.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does Mission BBQ Offer Online Ordering?

Yes, you can easily order online for takeout or delivery through the Mission BBQ website or third-party delivery platforms.

What Are the Most Popular Items on the Menu?

Brisket, pulled pork, and ribs are among the most popular items on the Mission BBQ menu, along with sides like mac and cheese, potato salad, and baked beans.

Does Mission BBQ Offer Catering Services?

Yes, Mission BBQ offers catering services for events of all sizes. You can choose from preset catering packages or customize your order.

Don’t miss the Chili’s Happy Hour Deals with unbeatable food and drink specials here.

Conclusion

Mission BBQ offers a delicious and authentic BBQ experience that caters to meat lovers, families, and groups of all sizes. With a wide range of menu items, delivery options, and catering services, Mission BBQ ensures that you can enjoy smoked meats, homemade sides, and signature sauces wherever you are. Whether you’re dining in, taking out, or ordering for delivery, Mission BBQ is committed to serving the best BBQ with a dedication to quality and service.
